IS 17354 : 2020 Medical Textiles-Dental Bib / Napkins-Specification
ICS 11.140; 59.080.01
TXD 36
New Standard from Last Update.
1 SCOPE
This standard specifies the requirements for dental bib/ napkins (disposable and reusable) intended for medical use.
2 REFERENCES
The standards listed in Annex A contain provisions, which through reference in this text, constitute provisions of this standard. At the time of publication, the editions indicated were valid.
